notes: HooksStoreToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Hooks Store (HOOKS) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the deploying factory. Transfers have no tax or burn. The token exposes no mint, burn, administrative or upgrade functions. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
